watched #writerPadmabhushan : I still can’t believe that I missed this movie on big screen 😞 MUST WATCH for its pure emotion…..

a movie which starts on a good note and continues with average stuff and entertainment here and there ends at an excellent note…..the last 30 mins is the heart of this movie which otherwise would have been an average fare!!!!

its been a cake walk for Suhas…..but the show stealers are Rohini & Ashish Vidyarthi 🙏🙏🙏

the movie could have been made far much better for its pure emotion but the budget constraints might have led to the compromise but the scenes picturization and screenplay looks natural…..
